guides.definition: Executes parameterized SQL and maps each row to the selected type. Project dependency only: add Dapper and a database provider to a project; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages or open database connections.

parameters.name: rowType
parameters.description: Type used to map each returned row.

parameters.name: parameterName
parameters.description: Anonymous-object property matching the SQL parameter without @.

parameters.name: parameterValue
parameters.description: Value safely bound to the SQL parameter.

examples.title: Load active users
examples.code: var rows = await connection.QueryAsync<User>("select * from Users where IsActive = @isActive", new { isActive = true });
examples.explanation: Dapper binds the anonymous-object property to the matching SQL parameter and maps result columns by name.

guides.definition: Returns one mapped row or the type default when no row matches. Project dependency only: add Dapper and a database provider to a project; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages or open database connections.

parameters.name: rowType
parameters.description: Type used to map the returned row.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: Quoted parameterized query expected to return zero or one row.

parameters.name: parameterName
parameters.description: Anonymous-object property matching the SQL parameter.

parameters.name: parameterValue
parameters.description: Value safely bound to the SQL parameter.

examples.title: Find a user by identifier
examples.code: var row = await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<User>("select * from Users where Id = @id", new { id = 42 });
examples.explanation: QuerySingleOrDefault expects at most one row; multiple matches indicate a data or query invariant failure.

guides.definition: Runs a non-query SQL command and captures the affected-row count. Project dependency only: add Dapper and a database provider to a project; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages or open database connections.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: Quoted parameterized INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or command text.

parameters.name: parameterName
parameters.description: Anonymous-object property matching the SQL parameter.

parameters.name: parameterValue
parameters.description: Value safely bound to the SQL parameter.

examples.title: Deactivate a user
examples.code: var affected = await connection.ExecuteAsync("update Users set IsActive = 0 where Id = @id", new { id = 42 });
examples.explanation: ExecuteAsync parameterizes values and returns how many rows the database reports as affected.
